scripts.text:
[Praying Minister]
Ah! An Archbishop.
You have reached the state of light.
I hope you give happiness and honor to people during your adventures.
scripts.translation:
[祈禱的牧師]
啊！大主教。
您已達到了光明的境界。
願您在冒險中為人們帶來幸福與榮耀。

scripts.text:
[Praying Minister]
In front of the Almighty God Odin,
there shall be no person smarter than him,
and there will be no person more merciful than him.
scripts.translation:
[祈禱的牧師]
在至高無上的奧丁神面前，
沒有比他更智慧的人，
也沒有比他更仁慈的人。

scripts.text:
[Praying Minister]
All ministers of Odin should be diligent. They should never be too lazy to serve Odin.
scripts.translation:
[祈禱的牧師]
奧丁的所有牧師都應勤勉。他們絕不應因懶散而怠慢對奧丁的侍奉。

scripts.text:
[Praying Minister]
These days, I've heard that ministers are becoming lax in their duty to Odin and adorn themselves with the splendors of the world.
scripts.translation:
[祈禱的牧師]
最近，我聽說有些牧師對侍奉奧丁的職責變得懈怠，反而沉迷於世俗的榮華富貴。

scripts.text:
[Praying Minister]
If you see any of these ministers, can you ask to them to go to the church in prontera?
scripts.translation:
[祈禱的牧師]
如果您遇到這樣的牧師，能否請他們去普隆德拉的教堂一趟？

scripts.text:
[Praying Minister]
They give out a special aura so you can easily recognize them.
I'm going to make them ministers worthy of serving Odin.
scripts.translation:
[祈禱的牧師]
他們會散發出特殊的氣息，所以很容易辨認。
我會讓他們成為配得上侍奉奧丁的牧師。

scripts.text: You can't change jobs without using all your skill points. Please use all of your skill points before applying to change jobs~
scripts.translation: 您必須用完所有技能點才能轉職。請在申請轉職前用完所有技能點~

scripts.text:
[Praying Minister]
{0}, how has your life been? Have you lived it to its fullest?
Have you served your life in the light of Odin?
scripts.translation:
[祈禱的牧師]
{0}，您過得如何？您是否活得充實？
您是否在奧丁的光輝下度過您的一生？

scripts.text:
[Praying Minister]
We are ministers and our behavior is seen as acts of the Gods.
We should always be mindful of this.
scripts.translation:
[祈禱的牧師]
我們是牧師，我們的行為被視為神明的作為。
我們必須時刻銘記這一點。

scripts.text:
[Praying Minister]
We should always tell the truth.
We should not fall prey to lies and deceit.
scripts.translation:
[祈禱的牧師]
我們應始終說真話。
我們不應陷入謊言與欺騙之中。

scripts.text:
[Praying Minister]
{0}...
Even though we serve Odin, we are normal people.
We can be degraded in spite of ourselves and we must realize that.
scripts.translation:
[祈禱的牧師]
{0}...
儘管我們侍奉奧丁，但我們也是普通人。
我們可能會在不知不覺中墮落，我們必須意識到這一點。

scripts.text:
[Praying Minister]
We always try to keep our original intention in mind and spread Odin's rule.
scripts.translation:
[祈禱的牧師]
我們總是努力銘記初心，並傳播奧丁的教義。

scripts.text: How do I become like that?
scripts.translation: 我怎樣才能做到那樣？

scripts.text:
[Praying Minister]
That's a good question.
We have lots of methods.
But, I recommend this.
scripts.translation:
[祈禱的牧師]
問得好。
我們有很多方法。
但我推薦這一種。

scripts.text:
[Praying Minister]
Have you ever heard of a ^3131FFHoly Pilgrimage^000000?
A Holy Pilgrimage means going to a holy place to pray to the God Odin for protection and grace.
scripts.translation:
[祈禱的牧師]
您聽說過^3131FF神聖朝聖^000000嗎？
神聖朝聖是指前往聖地，向奧丁神祈禱，祈求庇佑與恩典。

scripts.text:
[Praying Minister]
When you pray to Odin in the holy place, you will feel that you are born again.
scripts.translation:
[祈禱的牧師]
當您在聖地向奧丁祈禱時，您會感到自己獲得了新生。

scripts.text:
[Praying Minister]
What do you think?
Would you like to do a Holy Pilgrimage?
scripts.translation:
[祈禱的牧師]
您覺得如何？
您願意進行一次神聖朝聖嗎？

scripts.text: Yes I want to.
scripts.translation: 是的，我願意。

scripts.text: I'll think about it.
scripts.translation: 我再考慮一下。

scripts.text:
[Praying Minister]
That's the correct attitude.
A person who lives in one's mundane life would better have a new mind and body and evolve to the way of a true minister of Odin.
scripts.translation:
[祈禱的牧師]
這是正確的態度。
一個生活在世俗中的人，最好能擁有新的心靈與身體，進化為奧丁真正牧師的境界。

scripts.text:
[Praying Minister]
There is a small village named Umbala far from here.
That village is a where a tribe lives in harmony with nature.
scripts.translation:
[祈禱的牧師]
在離這裡很遠的地方，有一個叫汶巴拉的小村莊。
那個村莊裡，一個部落與自然和諧共處。

scripts.text:
[Praying Minister]
Go there and find Priest Dayan.
Tell him exactly,
'^3131FFI'm here for the Holy Pilgrimage.^000000'
scripts.translation:
[祈禱的牧師]
去那裡找到牧師 達揚。
告訴他：
'^3131FF我是來接受神聖朝聖的。^000000'

scripts.text:
[Praying Minister]
He's very old so he is hard of hearing.
You have to speak loud and clearly. You got it?
I hope that this paves the way for you to live in the light of Odin.
scripts.translation:
[祈禱的牧師]
他年紀很大，耳朵不太好使。
你必須大聲且清晰地說話。明白了嗎？
我希望這能為你鋪平道路，讓你沐浴在奧丁的光輝中。

scripts.text:
[Praying Minister]
Mmmm...
A Holy Pilgrimage isn't that difficult.
Just be mindful that once you start the path you will be on your way to the way of a true minister of Odin.
scripts.translation:
[祈禱的牧師]
嗯...
神聖朝聖並沒有那麼困難。
只要記住，一旦踏上這條路，你就在通往奧丁真正牧師的道路上了。

scripts.text:
[Praying Minister]
Feel free to visit me if you change your mind.
I'll always be here for you.
scripts.translation:
[祈禱的牧師]
如果你改變主意，隨時可以來找我。
我會一直在這裡等你。

歡迎，{0}。

scripts.text: The old priest gives you a gracious smile.
scripts.translation: 老牧師對你露出了和藹的微笑。

scripts.text:
[Priest Dayan]
See this village with the huge forest surrounding it.
Can you see a giant tree?
scripts.translation:
[牧師 達揚]
看看這個被巨大森林環繞的村莊。
你能看到那棵巨大的樹嗎？

scripts.text:
[Priest Dayan]
That big tree is called The ^3131FFYggdrasil^000000.
That tree was created from Ymir's body after Odin created the world as you know it, Midgard.
scripts.translation:
[牧師 達揚]
那棵大樹叫做^3131FF世界樹^000000。
傳說在奧丁創造了你所熟知的世界——米德加爾特之後，這棵樹是由尤彌爾的身體化成的。

scripts.text:
[Priest Dayan]
A fountain pours out from the end of Yggdrasil's roots that spread to every world.
scripts.translation:
[牧師 達揚]
世界樹的根系延伸至各個世界，從根部的末端湧出了泉水。

scripts.text:
[Priest Dayan]
The roots head to Niflheim where you can find the Hvergelmir spring.
In Midgard there is Mimir's spring.
And in Asgard, the world of the Gods, there is the Word spring.
scripts.translation:
[牧師 達揚]
根系通向尼弗爾海姆，那裡可以找到赫瓦格密爾之泉。
在米德加爾特有米米爾之泉。
而在眾神的世界阿斯加德，則有烏爾德之泉。

scripts.text:
[Priest Dayan]
Mimir's spring wells with intelligence, myth says that if Odin lets you have his eye that you will gain all of the knowledge within that spring.
scripts.translation:
[牧師 達揚]
米米爾之泉湧動著智慧。傳說如果奧丁允許你擁有他的一隻眼睛，你就能獲得泉中蘊含的所有知識。

scripts.text:
[Priest Dayan]
Enter the Yggdrasil.
You may be assaulted by creatures in there
but be mindful that their intentions are only to protect the Yggdrasil.
scripts.translation:
[牧師 達揚]
進入世界樹吧。
你可能會受到裡面生物的攻擊，
但請記住，它們的意圖僅僅是保護世界樹。

scripts.text:
[Priest Dayan]
Follow your steps with purpose.
If Odin doesn't abandon you, you can reach the beginning of the world at the stem of the Yggdrasil.
When you arrive there, find a quiet place.
scripts.translation:
[牧師 達揚]
帶著目的跟隨你的腳步前行。
如果奧丁沒有拋棄你，你就能到達世界樹樹幹處的世界起源之地。
當你到達那裡時，找一個安靜的地方。

scripts.text:
[Priest Dayan]
Pray for a life of faith and expiate your sins with a pious mind.
scripts.translation:
[牧師 達揚]
懷著虔誠的心祈禱，以信仰度過一生，並贖清你的罪孽。

scripts.text:
[Priest Dayan]
Admire Odin's omniscience and omnipotence and pray for a wisdom to choose the right path.
^3131FFFeel free to ask me about how to pray^000000.
scripts.translation:
[牧師 達揚]
讚頌奧丁的全知全能，祈求獲得選擇正確道路的 wisdom。
^3131FF如果您想知道如何祈禱，請隨時問我^000000。

scripts.text:
[Priest Dayan]
Lets see, go to the place of the most famous creature from Odin.
scripts.translation:
[牧師 達揚]
讓我想想，去奧丁最著名的生物所在的地方吧。

scripts.text:
[Priest Dayan]
After making your pilgrimage, let's have a drink together and talk about your experience.
scripts.translation:
[牧師 達揚]
完成朝聖後，讓我們喝一杯，聊聊你的經歷。

scripts.text: - Priest Dayan smiles again. -
scripts.translation: - 牧師 達揚再次露出了微笑。 -

scripts.text:
[Priest Dayan]
This place is the holiest place in the world, Yggdrasil.
This holy ceremony will brighten your soul.
scripts.translation:
[牧師 達揚]
這裡是世界上最神聖的地方，世界樹。
這場神聖的儀式將照亮你的靈魂。

scripts.text: How should I pray?
scripts.translation: 我該如何祈禱？

scripts.text: Cancel.
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Priest Dayan]
Through prayer, we can follow four paths.
Remember what I say to you now.
scripts.translation:
[牧師 達揚]
通過祈禱，我們可以遵循四條道路。
請記住我現在告訴你的話。

scripts.text:
[Priest Dayan]
The 1st way is the ^3131FFway of meditation^000000.
In the way of meditation, we have to be ready to greet Odin with a clear conscience.
scripts.translation:
[牧師 達揚]
第一條是^3131FF冥想之道^000000。
在冥想之道中，我們必須準備好以清白的良心迎接奧丁。

scripts.text:
[Priest Dayan]
Meditation starts with a ^3131FFBlessing^000000 which calms your mind down.
scripts.translation:
[牧師 達揚]
冥想始於^3131FF天使之賜福^000000，它能讓你平靜下來。

scripts.text:
[Priest Dayan]
The 2nd is the ^3131FFway of agony^000000.
Through the way of agony, we reflect on ourselves with confession about our retribution for the deeds of a former life.
scripts.translation:
[牧師 達揚]
第二條是^3131FF痛苦之道^000000。
通過痛苦之道，我們懺悔前世的行為，反思自己。

scripts.text:
[Priest Dayan]
Don't be afraid of pain. That is a necessity and will be a first step to enter a way to liquidate past wounds.
scripts.translation:
[牧師 達揚]
不要害怕痛苦。這是必要的，也是進入治癒過去傷痛之路的第一步。

scripts.text:
[Priest Dayan]
The 3rd way is the ^3131FFway of joy^000000.
As you rid yourself of pain, your mind will suffer less and you will experience the joy of life as you help and console others.
scripts.translation:
[牧師 達揚]
第三條是^3131FF喜悅之道^000000。
當你擺脫痛苦，心靈受苦更少，在幫助和安慰他人時，你將體驗到生命的喜悅。

scripts.text:
[Priest Dayan]
They will bless you because you are an existence of joy overcoming an affliction. We call that ^3131FFAspersio^000000.
You must drink a ^3131FFHoly Water^000000 with appreciation of Aspersio.
scripts.translation:
[牧師 達揚]
他們會祝福你，因為你是克服苦難的喜悅存在。我們稱之為^3131FF灑水祈福^000000。
你必須懷著對灑水祈福的感激之情飲用^3131FF聖水^000000。

scripts.text:
[Priest Dayan]
The last way is the ^3131FFway of light^000000.
You are free from all sin because you were blessed from all creation.
scripts.translation:
[牧師 達揚]
最後一條是^3131FF光明之道^000000。
你從所有罪惡中解脫，因為你被所有創造物祝福。

scripts.text:
[Priest Dayan]
You were reborn as light, sing a ^3131FFGloria^000000 of joy and soul that loves you.
scripts.translation:
[牧師 達揚]
你重生為光，歌唱愛與你的靈魂和喜悅的^3131FF格洛麗亞^000000。

scripts.text:
[Priest Dayan]
After finishing all of these prayers, just stand up with a pious mind.
If your prayer is truthful, Odin will lend you his wisdom.
scripts.translation:
[牧師 達揚]
完成所有這些祈禱後，只需懷著虔誠的心站起來。
如果你的祈禱是真誠的，奧丁會賜予你智慧。

scripts.text:
[Priest Dayan]
Are you ready?
Okay, it's time to leave and exculpate yourself.
If your prayer is finished, let's talk.
scripts.translation:
[牧師 達揚]
你準備好了嗎？
好了，是時候離開並贖清自己了。
如果祈禱結束了，讓我們談談。

scripts.text:
[Priest Dayan]
I hope that my prayer can weaken your agony...
scripts.translation:
[牧師 達揚]
我希望我的祈禱能減輕你的痛苦...

scripts.text:
[Priest Dayan]
Oh, you've come back.
I can feel that you have a fresh energy.
Maybe you did pray truthfully.
scripts.translation:
[牧師 達揚]
哦，你回來了。
我能感覺到你充滿了新的活力。
也許你確實真誠地祈禱了。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I feel light-hearted. Like I was just reborn...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我感到輕鬆。就像剛剛重生了一樣...

scripts.text:
[Priest Dayan]
Your faith gives you confidence and courage.
A smile from a peaceful mind will easily rid people of their wariness.
Please, inspire people with love and energy.
scripts.translation:
[牧師 達揚]
你的信任賦予了你自信與勇氣。
帶著平和心態的微笑，能輕易消除人們的戒備。
請帶著愛與活力去鼓舞人們吧。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Thanks for your kind words.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
謝謝你的美言。

scripts.text:
[Priest Dayan]
That place is Hugel in Schwarzwald.
There is a Nun praying there named Vinue,
she is a true minister who prays for the suffering people in the world.
But the last time I saw her she seemed sad.
scripts.translation:
[牧師 達揚]
那個地方是修瓦魯茲巴魯德的毀葛。
那裡有一位名叫維努的修女正在祈禱，
她是一位真正的大臣，為世間受苦的人們祈禱。
但我上次見她時，她看起來很悲傷。

scripts.text:
[Priest Dayan]
Can you convince her to make a pilgrimage to Yggdrasil?
I think she is exhausted due to praying too much.
I hope the air of Yggdrasil will be helpful to her.
scripts.translation:
[牧師 達揚]
你能勸她前往世界樹進行朝聖嗎？
我想她是因為祈禱太多而精疲力竭了。
我希望世界樹的氣息能對她有所幫助。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Don't worry.
I'll go and meet her.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
別擔心。
我會去見她的。

scripts.text:
[Priest Dayan]
Thank you very much.
Feel free to visit here when you want to pray, {0}
A visit from a friend always makes me happy.
scripts.translation:
[牧師 達揚]
非常感謝你。
{0}，想祈禱的時候隨時歡迎來這裡。
朋友的來訪總是讓我很開心。

scripts.text:
[Dayan]
Did you find Vinue in Hugel? How's she doing?
scripts.translation:
[達揚]
你在毀葛找到維努了嗎？她怎麼樣了？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Is it the spring of Hvergelmir.
This place is a very vivid and peaceful place.
It's proper to pray.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
這是赫維格爾密爾的春天。
這裡是一個充滿生機且寧靜的地方。
很適合祈禱。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Time to genuflect...
Time to start...
Hmm, what did that priest say to me?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
該跪拜了...
該開始了...
嗯，那位牧師對我說了什麼來著？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Hmm... What is the first way?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
嗯...第一條路是什麼？

scripts.text: The way of silence.
scripts.translation: 沉默之道

scripts.text: The way of confession.
scripts.translation: 懺悔之道

scripts.text: The way of meditation.
scripts.translation: 冥想之道

scripts.text:
[{0}]
The way of silence...?
I don't think so.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
沉默之道...？
我覺得不是。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
The way of confession...?
I don't think so.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
懺悔之道...？
我覺得不是。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
The way of meditation...?
Yes, it's the way of meditation.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
冥想之道...？
是的，是冥想之道。

scripts.text:
^3131FF[Priest Dayan]^000000
^3131FFThe 1st way is the way of meditation.^000000
^3131FFIn the way of meditation, we have to be ready to greet Odin with a clear conscience.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3131FF[牧師 達揚]^000000
^3131FF第一條路是冥想之道。^000000
^3131FF在冥想之道中，我們必須準備好以清白的良心迎接奧丁。^000000

scripts.text:
^3131FF[Priest Dayan]^000000
^3131FFMeditation starts with a Blessing which calms your mind down.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3131FF[牧師 達揚]^000000
^3131FF冥想始於天使之賜福，它能讓你平靜下來。^000000

scripts.text: - You close your eyes slowly and take a deep breath. -
scripts.translation: - 你緩緩閉上眼睛，深吸一口氣。 -

scripts.text: - * BLESSING! * -
scripts.translation: - * 天使之賜福！ * -

scripts.text:
Your mind is refreshed with the blessing effect.
You continue to meditate trying to rid your mind of any ill feelings.
scripts.translation:
在賜福的效果下，你的思緒變得清明。
你繼續冥想，試圖驅散心中所有的負面情緒。

scripts.text:
^3131FF[Priest Dayan]^000000
^3131FFThe 2nd is the way of agony^000000.
^3131FFThrough the way of agony, we reflect on ourselves with confession about our retribution for the deeds of a former life.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3131FF[牧師 達揚]^000000
^3131FF第二條路是痛苦之道^000000。
^3131FF通過痛苦之道，我們懺悔前世的行為，反思自己應得的報應。^000000

scripts.text:
^3131FF[Priest Dayan]^000000
^3131FFDon't be afraid of pain. That is a necessity and will be a first step to enter a way to liquidate past wounds.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3131FF[牧師 達揚]^000000
^3131FF不要害怕痛苦。這是必要的，也是邁向治癒過往創傷的第一步。^000000

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Pain... What kind of faults have I had?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
痛苦...我究竟犯下了什麼過錯？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I confess my guilt to the Almighty God Odin.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我向全能的神奧丁懺悔我的罪孽。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Oh benevolent Odin, Take mercy on me and pity me because I'm remiss in the discharge of my duties as a minister.
Please, lead the way and save a foolish minister with your wisdom.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
仁慈的奧丁啊，請憐憫我，因為我身為大臣，未能盡到職責。
求您指引道路，用您的智慧拯救我這個愚蠢的大臣。

scripts.text: You ruminate about your confession and are lost in thought again.
scripts.translation: 你反覆咀嚼著懺悔的內容，再次陷入了沉思。

scripts.text:
^3131FF[Priest Dayan]^000000
^3131FFThe 3rd way is the way of joy.^000000
^3131FFAs you rid yourself of pain, your mind will suffer less and you will experience the joy of life as you help and console others.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3131FF[牧師 達揚]^000000
^3131FF第三條路是喜悅之道。^000000
^3131FF當你擺脫痛苦，心靈受到的折磨就會減少，當你幫助和安慰他人時，你將體驗到生命的喜悅。^000000

scripts.text:
^3131FF[Priest Dayan]^000000
^3131FFAnd also they will bless you because you are an existence of joy overcoming an affliction. We call that Aspersio^000000.
^3131FFYou must drink a Holy Water with appreciation of Aspersio.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3131FF[牧師 達揚]^000000
^3131FF同時，他們也會祝福你，因為你是克服苦難的喜悅存在。我們稱之為灑水祈福^000000。
^3131FF你必須懷著對灑水祈福的感激之情飲用聖水。^000000

scripts.text:
^3131FF[Priest Dayan]^000000
^3131FFYou're drinking the Holy Water.^000000

[{0}]
Oh no! I forgot to bring a Holy Water!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
糟糕！我忘記帶聖水了！

scripts.text: - You bow respectfully holding up a Holy Water and put the glass to your lips. -
scripts.translation: - 你恭敬地鞠躬，舉起聖水，將杯子送到唇邊。 -

scripts.text: - * ASPERSIO ! * -
scripts.translation: - * 灑水祈福！ * -

scripts.text:
^3131FF[Priest Dayan]^000000
^3131FFThe last way is a way of light^000000.^000000.
^3131FFYou are free from all sin because you were blessed from all creation.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3131FF[牧師 達揚]^000000
^3131FF最後一條路是光明之道^000000.^000000
^3131FF你因受到萬物的祝福而擺脫了一切罪孽。^000000

scripts.text:
^3131FF[Priest Dayan]^000000
^3131FFYou were reborn as light, sing a Gloria of joy and soul that love you.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3131FF[牧師 達揚]^000000
^3131FF你重生為光，歌唱著喜悅與靈魂之愛的格洛麗亞。^000000

scripts.text:
- You breath in deep and start to sing a Gloria.
A chord crashes out in the spring of Hvergelmir and a waterfall sound gives you a refreshing feeling. -
scripts.translation:
- 你深吸一口氣，開始吟唱格洛麗亞。
赫維格爾米爾的泉水中爆發出一陣和絃，瀑布般的聲響讓你感到神清氣爽。 -

scripts.text:
[{0}]
~Descendants of Heimdal gather under the Ash tree Yggdrasil.~
~The Curdan bird which sits on a branch brings me the wisdom of whole world.~
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
~海姆達爾的後裔聚集在世界樹尤克特拉希爾的阿什樹下。~
~棲息在枝頭的庫丹鳥為我帶來整個世界的智慧。~

scripts.text:
[{0}]
~The Curdan wolf protects me from all threats in the world.~
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
~庫丹之狼保護我免受世間一切威脅。~

scripts.text:
[{0}]
~The host of ballascalf, rise up from your seat. The whole world shouts for joy.~
~The father of light, the poet of wisdom, sing for me.~
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
~巴拉斯卡爾夫的主人們，請從座位上起身。整個世界都在歡呼雀躍。~
~光明之父，智慧之詩人，請為我歌唱。~

scripts.text:
[{0}]
~The host of a glittering glass, give me a holy prediction.~
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
~閃耀玻璃的主人們，請賜予我神聖的預言。~

scripts.text: - After you finish the song, you feel light and strong with abundant devotion. -
scripts.translation: - 歌聲結束後，你感到身心輕盈，充滿了虔誠的力量。 -

scripts.text:
[{0}]
That was refreshing.
I guess I should go back to Priest Dayan.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
真令人神清氣爽。
我想我該回去找牧師 達揚了。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
The song is over. It's time to go back to Priest Dayan.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
歌唱結束了。是時候回去找牧師 達揚了。

scripts.text: - There is a nun closing her eyes as she murmurs something which sounds like a prayer. -
scripts.translation: - 一位修女閉著眼睛，低聲吟誦著聽起來像祈禱文的話語。 -

scripts.text: Talk to her.
scripts.translation: 和她說話

scripts.text: Stay Quiet.
scripts.translation: 保持安靜

scripts.text: - You don't feel like disturbing her -
scripts.translation: - 你不想打擾她 -

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Umm, hello sister?

[Vinue]
Ah, Welcome.
It's not time to have a service yet...
Are you here to pray, {0}?
scripts.translation:
[維努]
啊，歡迎。
現在還不是舉行儀式的時候...
你是來祈禱的嗎，{0}？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I came here to say hello from Priest Dayan from Prontera.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我是普隆德拉的牧師 達揚派我來問好的。

scripts.text:
[Vinue]
Ah, Priest Dayan.
Is he good?
He is so cute even though he's old.
scripts.translation:
[維努]
啊，牧師 達揚。
他好嗎？
雖然年紀大了，但他真的很可愛。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
He told me that he was worried because when he saw you last time, you seemed sad.
He asks you to go on a Holy Pilgrimage.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
他說上次見到你時，你看起來很傷心，所以很擔心。
他邀請你去進行一次神聖的朝聖。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Umbala has the vital power of nature!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
汶巴拉擁有自然的活力！

scripts.text:
[Vinue]
Ah...
He's very kind. As are you {0}.
scripts.translation:
[維努]
啊...
他真好。你也是，{0}。

scripts.text:
[Vinue]
But don't worry.
I'm just a little tired because of a bad dream.
scripts.translation:
[維努]
但別擔心。
我只是因為做了個噩夢有點累。

scripts.text:
[Vinue]
Evil is always watching for our souls.
If you are indifferent to praying, it never misses an opportunity.
scripts.translation:
[維努]
邪惡總是在窺視我們的靈魂。
如果你對祈禱漠不關心，它絕不會錯過任何機會。

scripts.text: A dream? What kind of dream?
scripts.translation: 夢？是什麼樣的夢？

scripts.text: Your soul should be fine.
scripts.translation: 你的靈魂應該沒事。

scripts.text:
[Vinue]
Oh but that's where you're wrong.
My soul may be the most at risk.
Thank you for delivering the message.
I'll go back to my prayers.
scripts.translation:
[維努]
不，你錯了。
我的靈魂可能正處於最危險的境地。
謝謝你傳達訊息。
我要回去繼續祈禱了。

scripts.text:
[Vinue]
That is...
Actually I started to have a bad dream from the date I was appointed.
scripts.translation:
[維努]
其實...
從我被任命的那天起，我就開始做噩夢了。

scripts.text:
[Vinue]
At first, it was a dream that Valkyrie was sad and in darkness.
scripts.translation:
[維努]
起初，夢裡的瓦爾基里很悲傷，籠罩在黑暗之中。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Valkyrie?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
瓦爾基里？

scripts.text:
[Vinue]
Yeah...
She was crying in a pitch-black room.
Hanging down like a bird that had its wings cut.
scripts.translation:
[維努]
是啊...
她在漆黑的房間裡哭泣。
就像一隻被剪斷翅膀的鳥，垂頭喪氣。

scripts.text:
[Vinue]
But, as time went by, the dream became scarier. Now Valkyrie is arrested with chains and then finally she is dashed to pieces.
scripts.translation:
[維努]
但隨著時間推移，夢變得越來越可怕。現在瓦爾基里被鎖鏈束縛，最後被摔得粉碎。

scripts.text:
[Vinue]
What a cruel performance! I suddenly can't breathe properly and then I wake up.
scripts.translation:
[維努]
多麼殘酷的景象！我突然無法呼吸，然後驚醒過來。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
To have to see the death of Valkyrie, must be a tormenting dream.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
不得不目睹瓦爾基里的死亡，這一定是個折磨人的夢。

scripts.text:
[Vinue]
Is it just a nightmare?
Or do you think it is an omen?
scripts.translation:
[維努]
這只是噩夢嗎？
還是你認為這是一個預兆？

scripts.text:
[Vinue]
I've been wanting to pray at Odin's shrine to make the dream go away. But that shrine became a den of evil a long time ago.
scripts.translation:
[維努]
我一直想前往奧丁的神龕祈禱，讓噩夢消失。但那個神龕很久以前就變成了邪惡的巢穴。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
The shrine?
Nobody tried to subdue the evil?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
神龕？
沒有人嘗試過鎮壓那裡的邪惡嗎？

scripts.text:
[Vinue]
Unfortunately, I'm a nun who doesn't have any exorcism skill...
Residents of Hugel just stood aghast of the sight because they are not familiar with adventure.
scripts.translation:
[維努]
不幸的是，我只是一個沒有驅魔技能的修女...
毀葛的居民對冒險並不熟悉，只能驚恐地看著這一切。

scripts.text:
[Vinue]
These days, there are a lot of people because of the development of the Odin shrine, but their situation is not so good.
scripts.translation:
[維努]
最近因為奧丁神龕的開發，那裡的人很多，但他們的處境並不好。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Is the dream related with the evil in the Odin shrine?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
這個夢和奧丁神龕裡的邪惡有關嗎？

scripts.text:
[Vinue]
Hum... well.
I don't have any way to find out.
I don't have a method, so I just pray.
scripts.translation:
[維努]
嗯...好吧。
我沒有辦法查明真相。
我沒有方法，只能祈禱。

scripts.text: I'll investgate for you.
scripts.translation: 我會為你調查。

scripts.text: I'll pray with you.
scripts.translation: 我會和你一起祈禱。

scripts.text:
[Vinue]
Thank you.
I'll pray that the darkness stays away.
I hope you have a good time with the festival here in Hugel.
scripts.translation:
[維努]
謝謝你。
我會祈禱黑暗遠離。
希望你在毀葛的節日裡玩得開心。

scripts.text:
[Vinue]
Yeah?
But, it'll be scary inside!
There are lots of devils inside!
scripts.translation:
[維努]
是嗎？
但是裡面很可怕的！
裡面有很多惡魔！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
But I can't pretend to ignore a Sister who is in trouble?
I'm a minister who copes with lots of asceticism!
Entrust me.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
但我不能假裝無視一位陷入困境的修女吧？
我是一位經歷了許多苦行的大臣！
交給我吧。

scripts.text:
[Vinue]
Ah... I'm so worried....
I'll never forget your warm heart.
scripts.translation:
[維努]
啊...我好擔心....
我會永遠銘記您的熱心。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
How do I get to Odin shrine?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我怎麼去奧丁神龕？

scripts.text:
[Vinue]
There is a ferry on the right side of the church.
scripts.translation:
[維努]
教堂右側有一艘渡船。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Ok, wait for good news!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
好的，等待好訊息吧！

scripts.text:
[Vinue]
I'll pray for your safe return.
I hope that Odin gives you his protection as well.
scripts.translation:
[維努]
我會祈禱您平安歸來。
希望奧丁也保佑您。

scripts.text:
[Vinue]
I'll pray for your safe return.
scripts.translation:
[維努]
我會祈禱您平安歸來。

scripts.text:
[Vinue]
I feel refreshed.
It must be good news?
Thank the Gods.
scripts.translation:
[維努]
我感覺輕鬆多了。
一定是好訊息吧？
感謝神明。

scripts.text: You can see Valkyrie who has a despairing face.
scripts.translation: 你可以看到瓦爾基里絕望的面容。

scripts.text: Touch Valkyrie's Illusion.
scripts.translation: 觸碰瓦爾基里的幻覺

scripts.text: Turn away.
scripts.translation: 轉身離開

scripts.text: You lose your consciousness while getting a closer view of Valkyrie's Illusion.
scripts.translation: 當你更近距離地觀察瓦爾基里的幻覺時，你失去了意識。

scripts.text: Out of fear, you turn away from Valkyrie's illusion.
scripts.translation: 出於恐懼，你轉身離開了瓦爾基里的幻覺。

scripts.text:
- Wait a Sec !! -
- You are carrying too many items, -
- you won't be able to obtain any new items. -
- Please take off some items -
- and come for the challenge again. -
scripts.translation:
- 等一下！！ -
- 你攜帶的物品太多了， -
- 無法獲得任何新物品。 -
- 請卸下一些物品 -
- 然後再來挑戰。 -

scripts.text:
[Valkyrie]
If you want to talk with me, you have to ^3131FFcancel all contracts^000000 with any mercenaries you have.
scripts.translation:
[瓦爾基里]
如果你想和我說話，你必須^3131FF解除^000000與所有僱傭兵的契約。

scripts.text: You can't progress without using all your skill points. Please use all of your skill points before progressing~
scripts.translation: 在沒有用完所有技能點的情況下無法繼續。請在繼續之前用完所有技能點~

scripts.text:
[Valkyrie]
In the heavens the sound of pipes spread out, but a bird that can't fly crawls and finally is crushed to pieces on the ground.
Ah, I'm resentful! so regretful!
scripts.translation:
[瓦爾基里]
在天空中，管樂聲四起，但一隻無法飛翔的鳥在地上爬行，最終被碾得粉碎。
啊，我充滿了怨恨！如此遺憾！

scripts.text: - Valkyrie holds its face, then she finds you and stares with a threatening face. -
scripts.translation: - 瓦爾基里捂住臉，然後發現你，用威脅的眼神盯著你。 -

scripts.text:
[Valkyrie]
You are a descendant of Heimdal living in pain as a mortal, why are you in here?
Are you here to ridicule my grim fate?
scripts.translation:
[瓦爾基里]
你是生活在痛苦中的海姆達爾後裔，為什麼在這裡？
你是來嘲笑我悲慘的命運嗎？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
No way!
But it's true that I'm here for you.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
不可能！
但確實，我是為了你而來的。

scripts.text:
[Valkyrie Anguhilde]
...me?
Of course I'm staying in Midgard, but we are under the yoke of fate that can't coexist in this world.
scripts.translation:
[瓦爾基里 安古希爾德]
...我嗎？
我當然會留在米德加爾特，但我們被命運束縛，無法在這個世界共存。

scripts.text:
[Valkyrie Anguhilde]
I see, is your goal to enter Valhalla?
If you do, it's the wrong place for you.
scripts.translation:
[瓦爾基里 安古希爾德]
我明白了，你的目標是進入英靈殿？
如果是那樣，你選錯了地方。

scripts.text:
[Valkyrie Anguhilde]
I was already expelled from Asgard.
My duty is protecting this small island from humans trying to take it from the Gods and even I don't have any energy to do so.
scripts.translation:
[瓦爾基里 安古希爾德]
我早已被逐出阿斯加德。
我的職責是保護這座小島，防止人類從眾神手中奪走它，但我連做這件事的<死亡騎士>能量都沒有了。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
It's not that kind of problem.
But someone who perceives your painful situation has sent me here.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
不是那種問題。
但有人察覺到了你痛苦的處境，派我來到這裡。

scripts.text:
[Valkyrie Anguhilde]
Haha! You are going to help me?!
scripts.translation:
[瓦爾基里 安古希爾德]
哈哈！你要幫我？！

scripts.text:
[Valkyrie Anguhilde]
...................
- Valkyrie gives you a fierce scowl. -
scripts.translation: - 瓦爾基里 安古希爾德狠狠地瞪了你一眼。 -

scripts.text:
[Valkyrie Anguhilde]
In fact, I can't do anything with my body now.
scripts.translation:
[瓦爾基里 安古希爾德]
事實上，我現在身體動彈不得。

scripts.text:
[Valkyrie Anguhilde]
Human, answer me. Are you here to sincerely help me?
scripts.translation:
[瓦爾基里 安古希爾德]
人類，回答我。你是真心來幫我的嗎？

scripts.text: Yes
scripts.translation: 是

scripts.text: No
scripts.translation: 否

scripts.text:
[Valkyrie Anguhilde]
I knew that I couldn't trust a human!
scripts.translation:
[瓦爾基里 安古希爾德]
我就知道不能相信人類！

scripts.text:
[Valkyrie Anguhilde]
Ok...
I don't have any energy to hold my own, so I have no choice but to trust you.
scripts.translation:
[瓦爾基里 安古希爾德]
好吧...
我沒有<死亡騎士>能量來維持自身，所以我別無選擇，只能信任你了。

scripts.text:
[Valkyrie Anguhilde]
I was a normal Valkyrie that lead soldiers to Valhalla according to the order of Odin.
scripts.translation:
[瓦爾基里 安古希爾德]
我原本是一名普通的瓦爾基里，按照奧丁的命令引導士兵進入英靈殿。

scripts.text:
[Valkyrie Anguhilde]
But I harmed Freki, one of Odin's wolves, and I was expelled form Asgard without any energy as a Valkyrie with orders to protect this island.
scripts.translation:
[瓦爾基里 安古希爾德]
但我傷害了奧丁的狼弗雷基，因此被逐出阿斯加德，失去了作為瓦爾基里的<死亡騎士>能量，只被命令保護這座島嶼。

scripts.text:
[Valkyrie Anguhilde]
I was disgraced, this island is important as a temple for Odin and the various Gods.
I tried to do my best to protect this holy place.
scripts.translation:
[瓦爾基里 安古希爾德]
我身敗名裂，這座島嶼對奧丁和眾神來說是一座重要的神殿。
我曾竭盡全力保護這片聖地。

scripts.text:
[Valkyrie Anguhilde]
But one day, the devil started to gain influence on this island.
I don't know why they came here and from where they came from.
scripts.translation:
[瓦爾基里 安古希爾德]
但有一天，惡魔開始在這座島上獲得影響力。
我不知道它們為什麼來這裡，也不知道它們來自哪裡。

scripts.text:
[Valkyrie Anguhilde]
They sieged the temple and I exhausted my energy trying to fight them all myself.
scripts.translation:
[瓦爾基里 安古希爾德]
它們圍攻了神殿，我耗盡了<死亡騎士>能量，試圖獨自與它們戰鬥。

scripts.text:
[Valkyrie Anguhilde]
The holy shrine was tainted by the devils.
How long do I have to be under this dishonorable fate!
scripts.translation:
[瓦爾基里 安古希爾德]
神聖的神龕被惡魔玷汙了。
我還要在這種恥辱的命運中忍受多久！

scripts.text:
[Valkyrie Anguhilde]
Mortal one, what is your name?
scripts.translation:
[瓦爾基里 安古希爾德]
凡人，你叫什麼名字？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
My name is {1}.

[Valkyrie Anguhilde]
{0},
You told me that you want to help me, right? Even though it disgraces me, I am asking for your help.
scripts.translation:
[瓦爾基里 安古希爾德]
{0}，
你說過要幫我，對吧？雖然這讓我感到羞恥，但我還是請求你的幫助。

scripts.text:
[Valkyrie Anguhilde]
This place may look like it was made my humans. Actually, it's a very important monument and also a part of the God's history.
scripts.translation:
[瓦爾基里 安古希爾德]
這裡看起來像是人類建造的。
但實際上，這是一座非常重要的紀念碑，也是神的歷史的一部分。

scripts.text:
[Valkyrie Anguhilde]
I've lost all of my energy and my body is sealed so there is no way for me to protect the shrine.
You have to send a message to Valhalla to ask for help from a Valkyrie quickly.
scripts.translation:
[瓦爾基里 安古希爾德]
我已經耗盡了<死亡騎士>能量，身體也被封印了，所以無法保護神龕。
你必須向瓦爾哈拉傳送訊息，儘快請求瓦爾基里的幫助。

scripts.text: How can I do that?
scripts.translation: 我該怎麼做？

scripts.text:
[Valkyrie Anguhilde]
At the ^3131FFtop of the shrine^000000, You can contact to them with a ^3131FFGolden pipe^000000.
scripts.translation:
[瓦爾基里 安古希爾德]
在^3131FF神龕的頂部^000000，你可以用^3131FF金色的管道^000000與他們聯絡。

scripts.text:
[Valkyrie Anguhilde]
I'm going to give you a scroll of paper written in an ancient language.
In that scroll, there is my impersonation.
^3131FFIf you go outside, you can summon a Valkyrie with that scroll.^000000
scripts.translation:
[瓦爾基里 安古希爾德]
我會給你一張用古語寫成的紙卷。
那張紙卷裡有我的化身。
^3131FF如果你走到外面，可以用那張紙卷召喚出瓦爾基里。^000000

scripts.text:
[Valkyrie Anguhilde]
After you summon my impersonation, you have to find a ^3131FFBroken pipe^000000.
Maybe it'll be spread in the shrine...
scripts.translation:
[瓦爾基里 安古希爾德]
召喚出我的化身後，你需要找到^3131FF斷裂的管道^000000。
它們可能散落在神龕各處...

scripts.text:
[Valkyrie Anguhilde]
You have to go to the top of the shrine, collecting all broken pipes from the impersonation.
And then I'm going to take care of the matter.
scripts.translation:
[瓦爾基里 安古希爾德]
你需要去神龕的頂部，從化身那裡收集所有斷裂的管道。
然後我會來處理這件事。

scripts.text:
[Valkyrie Anguhilde]
An impersonation will help when you move or attack as you want through ^FF0000ALT+click^000000.
But you have to be careful if an imeprsonation falls down.
scripts.translation:
[瓦爾基里 安古希爾德]
當你想移動或攻擊時，可以通過^FF0000ALT+點選^000000來操控化身。
但如果化身倒下了，你必須小心。

scripts.text:
[Valkyrie Anguhilde]
When you finish preparing to go on, talk to me again.
It'll be a long journey...
scripts.translation:
[瓦爾基里 安古希爾德]
當你準備好出發時，再跟我說話。
這將是一段漫長的旅程...

scripts.text:
[Valkyrie Anguhilde]
{0} Did you finish preparing for your way of asceticism?
scripts.translation:
[瓦爾基里 安古希爾德]
{0}，你準備好開始你的苦行之路了嗎？

scripts.text:
[Valkyrie Anguhilde]
Hmm, someone is battling the devil in the shrine right now.
You just wait a minute while I'm finding who it is.
scripts.translation:
[瓦爾基里 安古希爾德]
嗯，現在有人正在神龕裡與惡魔戰鬥。
請稍等片刻，我去看看是誰。

scripts.text:
[Valkyrie Anguhilde]
Ok. Now I'm going to send you there.
^FF0000When you go there, you have to summon my impersonation with the scroll^000000. Don't forget.
scripts.translation:
[瓦爾基里 安古希爾德]
好的。現在我要送你去那裡。
^FF0000當你到達那裡時，必須用紙卷召喚我的化身^000000。別忘了。

scripts.text:
[Valkyrie Anguhilde]
I'm talking with another person now, so give me a second.
scripts.translation:
[瓦爾基里 安古希爾德]
我現在正在和另一個人說話，請稍等片刻。

scripts.text:
[Valkyrie Anguhilde]
Are you ok human?
It was not as easy as I expected.
Will you challenge again?
scripts.translation:
[瓦爾基里 安古希爾德]
你沒事吧，凡人？
這並不像我預期的那麼容易。
你要再挑戰一次嗎？

scripts.text:
[Valkyrie Anguhilde]
Hmm, someone is battling the devil in the shrine right now.
You just wait a minute while I'm finding who it is.
scripts.translation:
[瓦爾基里 安古希爾德]
嗯，現在有人正在神龕裡與惡魔戰鬥。
請稍等片刻，我去看看是誰。

scripts.text:
[Valkyrie Anguhilde]
OK. now I'm going to send you there.
^FF0000When you go there, you have to summon my impersonation with the scroll^000000.
An impersonation will help when you move or attack as you want through ^FF0000ALT+click^000000.
But you have to be careful if an impersonation falls down.
scripts.translation:
[瓦爾基里 安古希爾德]
好的。現在我要送你去那裡。
^FF0000當你到達那裡時，必須用紙卷召喚我的化身^000000。
當你想移動或攻擊時，可以通過^FF0000ALT+點選^000000來操控化身。
但如果化身倒下了，你必須小心。

scripts.text:
[Valkyrie Anguhilde]
I'm talking with another person now, so give me a second.
scripts.translation:
[瓦爾基里 安古希爾德]
我現在正在和另一個人說話，請稍等片刻。

scripts.text:
[Valkyrie]
If you want to talk with me, you have to ^3131FFcancel all contracts^000000 with any mercenaries you have.
scripts.translation:
[瓦爾基里]
如果你想和我說話，你必須^3131FF解除^000000與所有僱傭兵的契約。

scripts.text:
[Valkyrie Anguhilde]
The devil always makes an effort to agitate people's mind.
You don't have to care about their whisperings.
scripts.translation:
[瓦爾基里 安古希爾德]
惡魔總是試圖擾亂人們的心智。
你不必在意它們的低語。

scripts.text:
[Valkyrie Anguhilde]
Anyway I can feel my energy coming back.
Show me the stuff that you found.
scripts.translation:
[瓦爾基里 安古希爾德]
不管怎樣，我感覺我的<死亡騎士>能量正在恢復。
讓我看看你找到的東西。

scripts.text: - You show a golden piece of pipe to Valkyrie. -
scripts.translation: - 你向瓦爾基里展示了一段金色的管道。 -

scripts.text:
[Valkyrie Anguhilde]
Oh, It's a piece of pipe!
If you collect pieces, you can ask other Valkyries for help.
scripts.translation:
[瓦爾基里 安古希爾德]
哦，這是一段管道！
如果你收集齊這些碎片，就可以向其他瓦爾基里求助。

scripts.text:
[Valkyrie Anguhilde]
Because of a close battle, I could only get a little energy.
I'm going to give a ^3131FFnew ancient scroll^000000.
It'll be helpful to find the rest of pieces.
scripts.translation:
[瓦爾基里 安古希爾德]
由於激烈的戰鬥，我只恢復了一點點<死亡騎士>能量。
我會給你一張^3131FF新的古語紙卷^000000。
它會幫助你找到剩下的碎片。

scripts.text:
[Valkyrie Anguhilde]
Then I look forward to good news.
scripts.translation:
[瓦爾基里 安古希爾德]
那我期待你的好訊息。

scripts.text:
[Valkyrie Anguhilde]
Did you find the rest of the pieces?
scripts.translation:
[瓦爾基里 安古希爾德]
你找到剩下的碎片了嗎？

scripts.text:
[Valkyrie Anguhilde]
Hum?
I can see this one beside you.
scripts.translation:
[瓦爾基里 安古希爾德]
嗯？
我看到你旁邊有一個。

scripts.text:
[Valkyrie Anguhilde]
OK.
I'll complete the broken horn pipe!
scripts.translation:
[瓦爾基里 安古希爾德]
好的。
我會修復破碎的號角！

scripts.text:
[Valkyrie Anguhilde]
But the battle is not finished yet.
You remember a ^3131FFruined shrine on the center of the island^000000?
It'll be completed only when you use a horn pipe.
scripts.translation:
[瓦爾基里 安古希爾德]
但戰鬥還沒有結束。
你還記得島嶼中央那座^3131FF破敗的神龕^000000嗎？
只有使用號角時，它才會被修復。

scripts.text:
[Valkyrie Anguhilde]
I can feel the air around me is getting impure.
And feel the coldness of the pitch-black darkness.
This time will be dangerous.
scripts.translation:
[瓦爾基里 安古希爾德]
我能感覺到周圍的空氣變得汙濁。
還有那漆黑一片的寒冷。
這次會很危險。

scripts.text:
[Valkyrie Anguhilde]
I give you a necklace as a present.
But I'm not sure that It'll be helpful or not....
Take care.
Please, hurry up!
scripts.translation:
[瓦爾基里 安古希爾德]
我送你一條項鍊作為禮物。
但我不確定它是否會有幫助...
保重。
請快點！

scripts.text:
- Wait a Sec !! -
- You are carrying too many items, -
- you won't be able to obtain any new items. -
- Please take off some items -
- and come for the challenge again. -
scripts.translation:
- 等一下！！ -
- 你攜帶的物品太多了， -
- 無法獲得任何新物品。 -
- 請卸下一些物品 -
- 然後再來挑戰。 -

scripts.text:
You are on a riding pet,
so you cannot change your job.
Please unequip your riding pet and try again!
scripts.translation:
你正騎在寵物身上，
無法轉職。
請卸下坐騎後再試一次！

scripts.text:
[Valkyrie Anguhilde]
Did you collect all of the pieces of my horn pipe?
scripts.translation:
[瓦爾基里 安古希爾德]
你收集齊我號角的所有碎片了嗎？

scripts.text:
[Valkyrie Anguhilde]
I know you bent over backwards to help me, but I can't do anything without 2 pieces of horn pipe.
scripts.translation:
[瓦爾基里 安古希爾德]
我知道你竭盡全力幫助我，但沒有兩塊號角碎片，我什麼都做不了。

scripts.text:
[Valkyrie Anguhilde]
It can be dangerous, so let's go back.
scripts.translation:
[瓦爾基里 安古希爾德]
可能會有危險，我們回去吧。

scripts.text:
[Valkyrie Anguhilde]
Finally we finished all the preparations.
scripts.translation:
[瓦爾基里 安古希爾德]
終於，我們完成了所有準備。

scripts.text: Valkyrie holds the pipe and blows towards the sky.
scripts.translation: 瓦爾基里拿著號角，向天空吹去。

scripts.text: Booo - - - -
Booo - - -

[Valkyrie Anguhilde]
Assistance of Odin! Soldiers of Valhalla!
The holy place of the God Odin is tainted by darkness!
scripts.translation:
[瓦爾基里 安古希爾德]
奧丁的援助！英靈殿計程車兵們！
奧丁神的神聖之地被黑暗汙染了！

scripts.text:
[Valkyrie of the heavens]
Don't worry, Anguhilde.
Your desire has reached Valhalla.
The devils were removed by other Valkyries as you wanted.
scripts.translation:
[天界的瓦爾基里]
別擔心，安古希爾德。
你的願望已經傳到了英靈殿。
正如你所願，惡魔已被其他瓦爾基里清除。

scripts.text:
[Valkyrie Anguhilde]
Valkyries! Then is it safe now?
scripts.translation:
[瓦爾基里 安古希爾德]
瓦爾基里們！那麼現在安全了嗎？

scripts.text:
[Valkyrie of the heavens]
Yes Anguhilde.
Even though you were expelled because of an incident before, Odin said that he is reconsidering your banishment.
scripts.translation:
[天界的瓦爾基里]
是的，安古希爾德。
雖然你之前因為事故被放逐，但奧丁說他會重新考慮對你的放逐。

scripts.text:
[Valkyrie Anguhilde]
Ah! I can go back to Asgard!
scripts.translation:
[瓦爾基里 安古希爾德]
啊！我可以回到阿斯加德了！

scripts.text:
[Valkyrie of the heavens]
Don't make a hasty generalization.
But I think that good news will be sent to you.
scripts.translation:
[天界的瓦爾基里]
不要妄下結論。
但我相信，好訊息會傳到你那裡。

scripts.text:
[Valkyrie Anguhilde]
Honor to Odin!
I feel full of grace.
So bright and warm....
scripts.translation:
[瓦爾基里 安古希爾德]
榮耀歸於奧丁！
我感到充滿了恩典。
如此明亮而溫暖....

scripts.text: - Shoooo -

[Valkyrie of the heavens]
Set your mind at ease.
She went to a place where she is supposed to be.
scripts.translation:
[天界的瓦爾基里]
請放心。
她去了她該去的地方。

scripts.text:
[Valkyrie of the heavens]
I think you don't get it.
scripts.translation:
[天界的瓦爾基里]
我想你誤會了。

scripts.text:
[Valkyrie of the heavens]
Anguhilde is a Valkyrie who is dead for a long time ago.
Didn't you see a shrine covered by the devil?
Unfortunately, Anguhilde couldn't cope with the task and fell down.
scripts.translation:
[天界的瓦爾基里]
安古希爾德是很久以前就死去的瓦爾基里。
你沒看到被惡魔覆蓋的神龕嗎？
不幸的是，安古希爾德無法完成任務，倒下了。

scripts.text:
[Valkyrie of the heavens]
Here is an illusion of Anguhilde who doesn't want to be recognized.
She can't go to hell even when she is dead, and struggles from her constant nightmare.
scripts.translation:
[天界的瓦爾基里]
這裡是安古希爾德的<黑暗蒐集者>幻覺，她不想被認出。
即使死後，她也無法進入地獄，在不斷的夢魘中掙扎。

scripts.text:
[Valkyrie of the heavens]
But she is relieved by your favor.
Even though It's different with reality but now she may be able to rest in peace.
scripts.translation:
[天界的瓦爾基里]
但你的善意讓她得到了解脫。
雖然這與現實不同，但現在她或許能安息了。

scripts.text:
[Valkyrie of the heavens]
Human, the Valkyries are in your debt. Thank you.
I can't invite you as I want, but the power given by Odin can help you.
scripts.translation:
[天界的瓦爾基里]
人類，瓦爾基里們欠你人情。謝謝你。
我無法如你所願邀請你，但奧丁賜予的力量可以幫助你。

scripts.text:
[Valkyrie of the heavens]
Now, go back to your world.
The sound of the horn pipe and a bird's chirpings will be spread out for you.
scripts.translation:
[天界的瓦爾基里]
現在，回到你的世界去吧。
號角聲和鳥鳴聲將為你奏響。
